name: Marcus Graham
biography: Marcus Graham (born 11 October 1963) is an Australian film, television and stage actor, writer and director. He was known as a teenage heartthrob in the early 1990s while starring in the Australian TV soap E Street as the character Stanley 'Wheels' Kovac. Graham graduated from the Western Australian Academy of Performing Arts in 1983, before making his professional acting debut in 1986. He is the son of English-Australian actor Ron Graham.
